summaryZh: Pantham 实验室研究妊娠中胎盘功能的分子机制，目标是改善以胎盘为主要病因的妊娠疾病诊断和管理。团队结合高通量、计算和生理学方法。
researchQuestions: 妊娠中胎盘功能的分子机制是什么？

evidence.quote: The Pantham Laboratory applies a combination of high-throughput, computational and physiological approaches to decipher the molecular mechanisms of placental function in pregnancy, with the aim of improving the diagnosis and management of pregnancy disorders in which the placenta plays a primary role.
